svt_mipi_dsi_dual_device_agent Class Reference

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Defines DSI Dual Device agent with basic UVM components to receive data from DSI Dual Host and also drives response data.

DSI Dual Device agent contains Active and Passive components. DSI Device Drivers and DSI sequencers are an active components while DSI Dual Monitor & DSI Monitors works as a passive component. Active components can be disabled using configuration.

Based on the sequences, DSI Sequencers generate different packets and passes it to respective DSI Device Driver which drives the data on interface. Respective DSI Device Driver receives data from the interface and form the packet and sends response packet if needed. Respective DSI Device Monitor is used to monitor the signals on to the interface. And provide split packets to the DSI Dual Monitor. DSI Dual Monitor process the packets and create a single dsi packet. DSI Dual Monitor also provides Analysis port to get single dsi packet transactions.

DSI sequencers are connected to respective DSI drivers with seq_item_port. Respective DSI Driver and DSI Monitor have an Analysis port to get transactions.

 svt_mipi_dsi_device  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_device_agent::dsi_driver[]

DSI Device drivers are an active components of this agent. Each DSI driver receive packets from respective DSI sequencer and transmits them to the respective PHY layer. From the PHY layer those data will be driven on to the interface. It also drives response packet to DSI host driver.

 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_monitor  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_device_agent::dsi_dual_monitor

DSI Dual Monitor process the packets and create a single dsi packet. DSI Dual Monitor can be disabled by setting configuration dsi_dual_monitor_enable = 0.

 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_coverage  attribute

 svt_mipi_dsi_monitor  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_device_agent::dsi_monitor[]

Each DSI Monitor instance is used to monitor signals on the interface. DSI monitors are passive components of this agent and can be disabled using monitor_enable bit for active components. DSI Monitors shall be disabled only during active configuration.

 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_device_agent::dsi_sequencer[]

DSI Device sequencers which transmits splitted packets to Device DSI drivers. It is an active component of this agent.
